name: 313. MiniMax chat content-safety flags (minimax sensitivity flags)
description: TXE-6595 (vendor sheet B1, contract C6): MiniMax reports whether its content filter fired in top-level input_sensitive, output_sensitive, input_sensitive_type and output_sensitive_type on every chat response (platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-chat-openai). Bifrost returns them under the same names on the unified chat response. A benign prompt must come back with all four present and input_sensitive false. The streamed terminal chunk carrying the flags is pinned by TestMiniMaxChatStreamCarriesSensitivityFlags in core/providers/minimax. The native /v1/responses and /anthropic/v1/messages cases for the same ticket stay in folder 284 next to the cases they replaced. The replay case sends MiniMax-shaped reasoning history (summary [], reasoning_text content) back to /v1/responses; that Bifrost keeps the reasoning item on the wire is pinned by TestMiniMaxResponsesReplaysReasoningContent. Rows 313.1 to 313.5 run against the provider error fixture (tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs, providerErrorFixture=1, no vendor key): the fixture's minimax answers chat for sensitive-flags with input_sensitive true and type 5, answers /v1/responses natively and serves /anthropic/v1/messages at the API origin, and GET /__wire shows what reached it. The two unnumbered rows assert what MiniMax's own filter and model return; they need a live MiniMax key, are skipped on a fixture run and stay structural-only in this program.

item.name: 313.1 fixture counters and recorded requests reset (minimax sensitivity flags)
313.2 /v1/chat/completions - MiniMax's flags (input_sensitive true, type 5) reach the unified response (minimax sensitivity flags)

exec: pm.test('served by minimax', function () { pm.expect(j.extra_fields && j.extra_fields.provider, pm.response.text()).to.equal('minimax'); });
pm.test('input_sensitive is the true MiniMax sent', function () { pm.expect(j.input_sensitive, pm.response.text()).to.equal(true); });
pm.test('input_sensitive_type is the 5 (abusive) MiniMax sent', function () { pm.expect(j.input_sensitive_type, pm.response.text()).to.equal(5); });
pm.test('output_sensitive is the false MiniMax sent', function () { pm.expect(j.output_sensitive, pm.response.text()).to.equal(false); });
pm.test('output_sensitive_type is the 0 MiniMax sent', function () { pm.expect(j.output_sensitive_type, pm.response.text()).to.equal(0); });
